CustomField.description: Groups the base64 chunks of ONE uploaded file. A large file is split client-side into several ~120KB base64 slices, each stored on its own guest-owned child de_OrderCapture__c row (de_CaptureData__c) sharing this upload key. Analyze Order gathers all rows with the same de_UploadKey__c, orders them by de_ChunkIdx__c, concatenates, and materializes a single ContentVersion. Lets uploads exceed the ~96KB single-field cap.
CustomField.label: Upload Key
